criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: S5 is the best frame, 2 to 1 at the thumb, held back by short shadow bands. S1 bold but thin. S9 dark but plainly a kit model. S2 the weakest, a mid-grey square on dark planks failing three of its own acceptance lines. S6 no dominant subject. S4 a primitive transformer. S8 a fused latch post with floating rings. S3's bays not registered to the louvres. S7 an honest relief that reads as a diagram. Four frames on a default puts it under 7.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One Caprock night under one key, the accent meaning planned, the turbine recurring, the camera walk legible. S2 strobes and S7 sits on the edge, the fence motif too faint.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces and the drawn counts match their figures. Looser wording on S7's Soluna says the extra 97 acres, S5's headline dropping up to, and the caption's it.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who, where, the condition and the timing are named. The decider and the next step are implied, not named.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The cover earns the swipe, the turn lands at S5, S8 is a sharp late beat. S7 restates S2 and S3 to S4 is a slow middle.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: On register and regionally specific with tight headlines. Flattens into attribution boilerplate and Drawn to illustrate on seven deks.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: New turbine cover, tower sections as the unit, the mesquite accent. lastLight, a transformer frame, a shut gate and a courthouse are familiar.

one_sentence_fix: Rebuild frame 2 as the full-bleed lit county relief its acceptance lines asked for.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A mid-grey mottled square on near-black panels, no neighbour relief, no bleed, a 25 px subject.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Pull in until Briscoe fills the width, lift the neighbours to lit red earth one value below the caliche, lower the key so the walls cast.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: No dominant subject, paper flags, a silhouette substation, a purple-grey pasture, dead dark under the headline.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Camera about 2 m from the nearest stake so it stands a third of the frame tall, cloth flags, raise the dek.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A primitive transformer with stacked disc bushings and invisible fences.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Crop to the radiator fin bank with headers, swap or crop the bushings, put the chain link sharp across the near foreground.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A fused latch post, floating rings, a flat tag, mid-tone caliche.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Linked chain from both frames to the padlock on one latch post, the pool pulled down so the rails and lock are brightest.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Flat orange planes not registered to the louvres, faint turbines and pole line.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Glow behind the hall's own louvre slats at lower saturation, rim light on the H-frame line.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Reads as a diagram board with an icon substation.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A small raised yard casting under the key, coarser furrow pitch.
